mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO analytics_outbox( event_id, application_id, user_id, action, occurred_at_ms, payload, state, next_attempt_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{applicationId}, #{userId}, #{action}, #{occurredAtMs}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', NOW(3) )
mapper.sql: event_id AS eventId, application_id AS applicationId, user_id AS userId, action AS action, occurred_at_ms AS occurredAtMs, payload AS payload, state AS state, attempts AS attempts, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, lease_owner AS leaseOwner, lease_until AS leaseUntil, sent_at AS sentAt, last_error AS lastError, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM analytics_outbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM analytics_outbox WHERE (state = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)) OR (state = 'SENDING' AND lease_until < NOW(3)) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE analytics_outbox SET state = 'SENDING', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, attempts = attempts + 1, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND) WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND ((state = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)) OR (state = 'SENDING' AND lease_until < NOW(3)))

UPDATE analytics_outbox SET state = 'SENT', sent_at = NOW(3), last_error = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND state = 'SENDING' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}
UPDATE analytics_outbox SET state = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = NOW(3), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND state = 'REVIEW'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics_outbox WHERE state IN ('PENDING','SENDING','REVIEW')
